dedupe_keys.name: code and data for tail reliability of metro bus bridging under spatially correlated road closures

description: The study team publishes code and processed network inputs for analysing pre-planned metro bus bridging during spatially correlated road closures. Zenodo provides a reproducibility ZIP under CC BY 4.0. The record identifies a revised twenty-seed experiment, machine-readable outputs and figure-source tables. The model compares tail reliability when closure events make intended replacement bus routes unavailable. It can test metro-disruption and bus-network contingency plans in transport simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this experiment package. Coverage is the study network and its fixed pre-event bridging policy, not every real closure sequence or adaptive dispatcher action. A limitation is that the own-page summary does not list route topology or closure-correlation parameters outside the archive. Reported twenty-seed results do not prove service reliability in another city. The ZIP was not downloaded, the code was not run and result tables were not independently checked.
